title: TGBS — _burnBlock Burn Mechanism Bypass Analysis
root_cause: The `_burnBlock()` function returns a block number used to determine whether token burning occurs; by performing 1,600+ self-transfers, the attacker bypasses the block number condition and accumulates large amounts of tokens without any burn
steps: → [1] DPP Flash Loan: borrow large amount of WBNB
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] DPP Flash Loan: borrow large amount of WBNB
  │
  ├─→ [2] Swap WBNB → TGBS
  │
  ├─→ [3] Repeat self-transfer 1,600 times
  │         └─ Advances past _burnBlock() condition block, bypassing burn
  │
  ├─→ [4] Extract accumulated TGBS via skim()
  │
  ├─→ [5] Swap TGBS → WBNB
  │
  └─→ [6] Repay flash loan + ~$150K profit
